primitive.Heading: Section titles from h1 to h3, with a display style for landing-page headlines.
primitive.Paragraph: Body text with readable line length and spacing.
primitive.Caption: Small muted text for labels, footnotes and image credits.
primitive.Text Effect: Animated text that reveals by character, word or line.
primitive.Math: Rendered math formulas, inline or as blocks.
primitive.Mood Text: Expressive text styled word by word with motion, font and glow presets.
primitive.Symbol: Icon glyphs sized and colored to match the text around them.
primitive.Marker: A small shape or dot that marks a point, status or list item.
primitive.Status: A colored dot and label for a state like active, pending or failed.
primitive.Badge: A small label for tags, counts and categories.
primitive.Pill: A split badge with a muted label and a contrasting value.
primitive.Chip: A pressable tag for filters, selections and quick actions.
primitive.Notification Badge: An unread dot or count pinned to an icon.
primitive.Indicator: A presence dot for online, away, busy or offline.
primitive.Image: Responsive image with loading and fallback states.
primitive.Avatar: A user photo with an initials fallback.
primitive.Aspect Ratio: Keeps content locked to a fixed width-to-height ratio.
primitive.Flip-Dots: An animated flip-dot board for text, clocks and patterns.
primitive.Table: A plain semantic table for rows and columns of data.
primitive.Button: Triggers an action, in several variants and sizes.
primitive.Bar: A single-line row with leading, label and trailing slots.
primitive.Cursor: Replaces the native cursor with a dot, ring, spotlight or trail.
primitive.Cursor Label: A label that follows the pointer and flips near edges.
primitive.Link: Styled inline or standalone navigation link.
primitive.Breadcrumb: Shows the path to the current page.
primitive.Tabs: Switches between panels of related content.
primitive.Text field: A labeled text input with helper and error text.
primitive.Slider: Picks a value or range by dragging a thumb.
primitive.Rater: A star rating in whole or half steps.
primitive.Thumbs: Thumbs up and thumbs down feedback, with optional counts.
primitive.Increment: A number nudged up or down with minus and plus buttons.
primitive.Input Calculator: A formula field that evaluates spreadsheet-style maths as you type.
primitive.Select: A styled dropdown for picking one option.
primitive.Native Select: The browser's native select, styled to match.
primitive.Checkbox: Turns an option on or off, with an indeterminate state.
primitive.Toggle: A button that stays pressed or unpressed.
primitive.Mode Toggle: Switches between light, dark and system themes.
primitive.Label: An accessible label for form controls.
primitive.Item: A list row with media, title, description and actions.
primitive.Card: A container for grouped content with header, body and footer.
primitive.Progress: A bar showing how far along a task is.
primitive.Progress Ring: Circular progress with an optional center value.
primitive.Skeleton: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads.
primitive.Steps: An ordered sequence that marks complete, active and upcoming steps.
primitive.Empty: A placeholder for empty lists and zero states.
primitive.Alert: An inline message for info, success, warning or errors.
primitive.Banner: An announcement bar, static or scrolling like a ticker.
primitive.Toast: Short messages that appear and dismiss on their own.
primitive.Accordion: Stacked sections that expand and collapse.
primitive.Collapsible: One region that shows or hides its content.
primitive.Dialog: A modal window over the page.
primitive.Alert Dialog: A modal that asks the user to confirm or cancel.
primitive.Sheet: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen.
primitive.Drawer: A draggable bottom panel for mobile.
primitive.Popover: Floating content anchored to a trigger.
primitive.Floating Window: Floats any element in one of nine spots, with optional drag and snap.
primitive.Hover Card: A preview card shown on hover.
primitive.Tooltip: A short hint shown on hover or focus.
primitive.Dropdown Menu: A menu of actions opened from a button.
primitive.Context Menu: A menu opened with a right-click.
primitive.Draggable: A sortable list you can reorder by drag or keyboard.
primitive.Stack: Lays children out vertically or horizontally with even gaps.
primitive.Masonry: A column layout for items of uneven height.
primitive.Array: Lays elements out along a line, arc, circle or path.
primitive.Resizable: Panels you resize by dragging a handle.
primitive.Direction: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left for its children.
primitive.Bento Grid: A grid of tiles in mixed sizes.
primitive.Card Grid: A card of small icon tiles, like a tray flyout.
primitive.Infinite Scroll: Any components in a list, grid or masonry that loads more as you scroll.
primitive.Parallax: Layers of any content that move at their own depth with scroll or the pointer.
primitive.Separator: A horizontal or vertical divider line.
primitive.Scroll Area: A scroll container with custom scrollbars.
primitive.Gradient: A linear, radial, conic or mesh gradient layer.
primitive.Noise: A grain, paper or cloud texture layer.
primitive.Pattern: A repeating pattern layer like dots, grids and stripes.
primitive.Image Shader: WebGL effects applied to an image.
primitive.Color Grade: Color filters like sepia, noir, vintage and duotone.
primitive.Distort: Wave, ripple, warp or blur effects.
primitive.Mask: A soft fade, vignette or spotlight cutout.
primitive.Surface: Stacks gradient, pattern, image, SVG and noise layers from props.
primitive.Art: Positioned art pieces that animate in, idle and drift with the pointer by depth.
primitive.Cell Grid: A grid of colored cells, the base for heatmaps.
primitive.PDF Display: A PDF viewer with open and download actions.
primitive.Markdown Display: Safely rendered Markdown with an optional source view.
primitive.SVG Display: An SVG preview with zoom, code view and download.
primitive.Video Display: A video player with custom controls.
primitive.Audio Display: An audio player with cover art and a waveform.
primitive.Draw Display: A touch-friendly sketch pad with SVG and PNG export.

component.Arrangeable Grid: An inventory-style grid of slots you rearrange by drag, between linked grids and onto drop targets.
component.List: A card of bars: menus, nav, launchers and folder trees with sections.
component.Toolbar Count: Result and selection counts for toolbars.
component.Dynamic Tabs: Browser-style tabs the user can add, close and rename.
component.Info Icon: An info icon that shows help text on hover or tap.
component.Carousel: Slides you swipe or step through.
component.Chart: Line, bar, area and pie charts with themed colors.
component.Heatmap: A matrix of values shaded on a color ramp.
component.Standard Table: A table with a toolbar for search, sorting and paging.
component.Button Group: Related buttons joined into one control.
component.Button Array: A row or grid of buttons generated from a list.
component.Refresh Button: Reloads data, with a spinning loading state.
component.Floating Action Button: A floating button for the main action on a screen.
component.Action Wheel: A radial menu of actions that opens at the cursor.
component.Toolbar: A row of grouped tools, toggles and selects.
component.Share Button: Opens the native share sheet or copies the link.
component.Print Button: Prints the page or a single element.
component.Download Button: Downloads a file from a URL or Blob.
component.Upload Button: Opens the file picker and returns the chosen files.
component.Webcam Button: Turns the camera on and off and hands back the stream.
component.Mic Button: Turns the microphone on and off, with a live level meter.
component.Volume Button: A mute button with a slide-out volume slider.
component.Email Button: Opens a prefilled email, or copies the address.
component.Copy Button: Copies text to the clipboard and confirms with a check.
component.Navigation Menu: Top-level site navigation with dropdown panels.
component.Control Bar: A bar of playback or editing controls.
component.Search: A search field with suggestions and recent queries.
component.Input OTP: A one-time code input, one box per digit.
component.Input Group: An input with attached icons, buttons or text.
component.Autocomplete Input: A text input that suggests matches as you type.
component.Number Input: A digits-only field that clamps to a min and max.
component.Phone Input: A phone number field with a country picker.
component.Input Fill: A masked input for phones, dates, cards and codes.
component.Lexical Editor: A rich text editor built on Lexical.
component.Color Picker: A swatch, hex field and presets for picking colors.
component.Filter Select: A multi-select for filtering lists and tables.
component.Miller Select: Picks from nested options in side-by-side columns.
component.Badge Select: A multi-select that shows picks as badges.
component.Field: Wraps a control with a label, description and error.
component.Form: Form layout with validation and submit handling.
component.Calendar: A month grid for picking dates.
component.Date Picker: Picks a date or range from a popover calendar.
component.Time Picker: Picks a time on a clock dial or by typing.
component.Calendar Heatmap: A contribution graph with one cell per day.
component.Dialslide: A horizontal slider row with scroll buttons.
component.Scroll Horizontal Button: Buttons that scroll a row left and right.
component.Radio Group: Picks exactly one option from a set.
component.Toggle Group: A set of toggles for one or many choices.
component.Loading State: Loading, error and empty states for async content.
component.Message: A chat message with avatar, name and timestamp.
component.Attachment: A file chip with icon, name and size.
component.Message Scroller: A chat thread that sticks to the newest message.
component.Card Bar: A row of cards that scrolls horizontally.
component.Responsive Tooltip: A tooltip on hover, a popover on touch.
component.Popover Wizard: A small multi-step panel for tours and quick setup.
component.Confirm Dialog: A dialog that confirms an action before it runs.
component.Tabbed Dialog: A dialog with tabs for grouped settings.
component.App Grid: A launcher grid of apps and folders.
component.Headline: One landing-page section: a display headline, one paragraph, one call to action and one image.
component.Infinite Canvas: A pan-and-zoom surface with draggable items, a grid and a minimap.

block.Table List: A searchable, filterable, paged list that switches between table and card grid views.
block.Table Grid: An editable grid of rows and columns with keyboard navigation.
block.Data Grid: An Excel-style spreadsheet with fill, filters, formatting and undo.
block.Spreadsheet: A Data Grid whose cells take formulas, ranges and named values.
block.Data Table: A TanStack table with sorting, filtering, paging and bulk actions.
block.Sidebar: A collapsible side navigation for apps.
block.App Bar: A top app bar with a title that collapses on scroll.
block.Navigation Bar: A bottom navigation bar for mobile.
block.Navigation Drawer: A slide-out drawer of navigation links.
block.Navigation Rail: A slim vertical rail of navigation icons.
block.Page Header: A page title with breadcrumbs, description and actions.
block.Questionnaire: A multi-question form, one step at a time.
block.Kanban: A board of columns with draggable cards.
block.Gantt: A project schedule of phases, tasks and milestones against a timeline.
block.Wizard: A multi-step form in a dialog or bottom sheet.
block.Article: A long-form article layout with rich typography.
block.Activity Overview: A year of activity with totals, streaks and a contribution graph.
block.Timeline: Events along a line, down the page or across it, with any element in each entry.
block.Comments: A comment section with a sort select, a reply box and a login prompt.
block.Chat Card: A chat window with a streaming-friendly thread, attachments and a composer.
block.Character Chat: A visual-novel dialogue box: a speaker's name, a typed-out line and a portrait, clicked through one line at a time.
block.Hero Card: A layered hero card with the headline, subheading and calls to action placed anywhere on a 3×3 grid.
